description: BFP8 weights on every layer, gelu_pytorch_tanh in the gated MLP, BFP4 LoFi LM head, BFP8 KV cache

groups.o: o_proj (row-parallel, decode all-reduce / prefill reduce-scatter after it)
groups.gate_up: gate_proj + up_proj (FF1 + FF3, column-parallel; prefill packed copy uses the same dtype)

activations.decode_intermediates_note: decode matmul outputs kept on chip (qkv, gate_up, the MLP product, norm outputs) are BF16; the o_proj and down outputs that feed the decode all-reduce take ccl.decode_all_reduce (BFP8)

logits.softcap: 30 * tanh(x / 30) on device into the persistent BF16 logits buffer

sampling.note: on-device two-level top-32 per chip over the vocab-sharded BF16 logits; greedy = lowest-id argmax

selection.replaces: b0_lmh4_lofi, the bring-up's speed-first selection: BFP4 weights on layers 13-26 / 35-39 and the fast GELU approximation. It scored 132 / 198 on GPQA Diamond against the 135 gate.
selection.accuracy: Teacher-forced on 8 GPQA Diamond reasoning traces (first 1000 generated tokens each, batch 8) against HF bf16 on CPU: KL(HF || TT) x 1000 over HF's top 20 73.9 -> 7.7, top-1 agreement 92.5% -> 97.6%, positions where HF is >= 90% sure and TT picks another token 12 -> 0 (HF fp32 vs bf16: 0.3 / 99.4% / 0). BFP8 weights alone give 28.1; the fast GELU was the larger share. Exact SDPA exp and HiFi2 matmuls moved KL by under 1.
selection.gpqa_diamond: 198 questions, thinking on, T 1.0 / top-k 20 / top-p 0.95, 32 concurrent: 144 / 145 / 144 at seeds 42 / 43 / 44 (tt-agentic-bringup-qb2 runs 41834786537 / 41845983159 / 41845991057); same-protocol GPU reference 74.24.
selection.speed: vLLM, local QB2: 128/128 one user 12.6 -> 13.3 ms/token, 32 users 1380 -> 1317 tok/s; 4096/128 one user 15.9 -> 16.6 ms/token.
